name: separation_objects
description: Render a complete object and five candidate decompositions, then ask which option correctly reconstructs the complete object.

difficulty_params.difficulty: Catalog object primitive part_count defines difficulty: 3-5 parts = easy, 6-10 parts = medium, 11+ parts = hard. part_count is fixed by the selected complete object and is not a generation option.

part_count.source: frontend/catalog.json entry for the selected complete object

difficulty_params.object_category: Dataset category such as Bench, Chair, Desk, Misc, Shelf, or Table.
difficulty_params.complete_object_visibility_filter: The active object pool excludes objects where any primitive part has less than min(5 pixels, 5% of that part's solo rendered area) visible across the two fixed complete-object views.
difficulty_params.option_visibility_filter: Generate and direct benchmark modes reject scenes where any primitive part shown in an option subassembly has less than min(13 pixels, 13% of that part's solo rendered area) visible in the option view.
difficulty_params.subassembly_count: 2 for the active revised option mode.
difficulty_params.split_balance_gap: Difference between the largest and smallest subassembly sizes for the correct decomposition.
difficulty_params.connection_relation_count: Number of part-part connections in the complete object graph.

subassembly_option_mcq.prompt: Which option shows the correct decomposition of the complete object?
